Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Buyer, Seller
public abstract class User extends Object
Abstract account superclass. The UML specialisations are Buyer, Seller and Admin; each subclass fixes its UserRole.

Simple in-memory model (no persistence). TODO: Replace with a real entity + repository when backend is added.
